retrievalProfile.description: A candid-style portrait of a musician with motion blur and vertical, margin-aligned typography for a 1990s alternative rock aesthetic.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a woman with dark hair, smiling and carrying an electric guitar, characterized by a soft motion blur and a desaturated, slightly warm color palette. The composition features a distinct vertical text strip on the far left margin, separated by a subtle vertical line.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject is slightly off-center to the right, balanced by a vertical text margin on the left.
The guitar's warm orange body provides a focal point against the cool blue-grey floor.
Motion blur on the subject's face and hair creates a sense of candid movement.
The background is divided into a cool-toned floor and a warm, out-of-focus wall.
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation along the left edge
Presence of a musical instrument as a prop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The orange electric guitar at the bottom left of the subject's silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sharpest point of the guitar, move up the subject's arm to the blurred face, then shift left to the vertical text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper left and lower right floor areas.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted beige and tan (background wall and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a matte, low-contrast finish in the blacks.

letterConstructionRules: Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
Open counters for legibility at small sizes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Bold weight for the primary name

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a dedicated vertical border strip

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family using weight contrast (bold vs. regular) and case contrast (lowercase vs. italic).
graphicDevices: Distressed paper-edge texture on the left margin

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 90s editorial weight and utilitarian feel.
Provides the clean, low-contrast look required for the margin text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a film-grain photograph of a woman with long dark hair in a brown tank top and cargo pants, smiling with motion blur, holding an electric guitar, in a minimalist industrial space with a blue-grey floor and tan wall. Leave a 10% vertical strip on the left edge empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical line 10% from the left edge. Inside that strip, place the artist name in bold sans-serif lowercase and the album title in italic sans-serif lowercase, rotated 270 degrees so the text reads bottom-to-top.

verificationChecks: Is there visible motion blur on the subject's face?
Is the color palette desaturated with a warm/cool split?
Is the text restricted to the left margin strip?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left margin strip
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or album title from the original.
Do not replicate the exact face of the individual.

mustAchieve: Intentional motion blur that doesn't obscure the smile

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is vertical and aligned to the left.
Verify the guitar is present and has a warm wood or orange tone.
Ensure the subject's expression is visible through the blur.
Confirm the presence of the vertical dividing line.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Musician] + Prop [Instrument] + Effect [Motion Blur] + Layout [Vertical Margin Text] = 90s Alternative Aesthetic
